registration_context: 32 source interface pilots completed: saved constant anchor succeeds 8/8, original first functional pair and swap and first constant fail 24/24. Source-data interface and 2022-fit visibility passed. No other announced 2023 library population outcomes observed.

selection.first_center: Among candidates completing all 73 source windows in both original source periods under the selection rule, compute per-period full-population mean cost and average its percentile rank equally across periods; smallest rank then profile ID chooses source first center. No fabricated failure objective and no 2024 outcome in scoring.
selection.source_support: If no common complete source candidate exists, retain full archive and freeze no source design. This support condition concerns defined comparable full costs, not a new 95-percent reliability threshold.
selection.geometry: Independent 18-coordinate cosine-plus-diagonal-square blocks for the two ordered channels; standardize each of 36 coordinates on all original 154 joint profiles, std<=1e-10 maps to scale 1. Both arms use this exact structural geometry.
selection.continuation: Farthest-first ten initial profiles over all original 154 candidates. Generic first center is full-library structural medoid; source first center is source-complete-cost best. Source support never restricts the target candidate domain.
selection.attribution: A source-only first-center intervention with shared structure, not the unmodified full augmented objective/safety atlas. Full augmented atlas remains unconnected because failed objective samples are undefined.

execution_budget.source_only_data: All source inputs cached; zero new API requests, optimizer calls, verifier calls or 2025 access.
execution_budget.storage: Compact disjoint shard journals; reuse and count 32 pilot calls once. Full journals remain server-side; small summaries only pulled.

decision: After full classification, freeze source-first and source-free structural designs or retain an empty-support negative. Register later retrospective 2024 comparison separately; do not access 2025 or launch target optimizer/verifier automatically.
limitations: Source archive is generated by announced analyst simulation on public historical signals, not an observed business policy archive.
